text.text_excerpt: I cannot say enough good things about this hotel! I was skeptical at first. I booked this room using my traveler points and I picked it because it was the least points that I needed to use. I had read reviews and everything seemed ok. We just needed a place to crash after a weekend of Jazz Fest. From check-in to check-out was nothing but a good experience. Stanley checked us in. He is the general manager and was a delight to deal with and was also very helpful about transportation and other tourist info. One thing that blew me away is that he remembered us the entire time we stayed. Calling us by name and saying hello. The room was clean and exactly what was needed. The hotel is older, so...

This hotel is just minutes away from Bourbon Street, Canal Street and the French Quarter. There is 24 hour security at the door. The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. The room was very clean and smelled good. I didn't have a single issue with this hotel. The best part was the price I received over value. This was the cheapest 4 star hotel near the French Quarter. When I go back to NOLA I will definitely stay at the Quality Inn and Suites again!

My boyfriend and I stayed at Quality Inn & Suites from October 11-15, 2014. Words cannot express how impressed we were with the service at this hotel! The staff were very friendly, helpful and polite. Every staff member made sure to say hello/enjoy your day each time we walked by, offered assistance with finding places, and made great suggestions on what to check out. We felt like they treated us like family/friends! The room itself was very clean. We were upgraded to a Queen suite which was very spacious. There was a small kitchenette which came in handy as well. Overall, we were very happy with our stay and if we ever return to New Orleans, we will be sure to stay here again.
